component.name: Chapeau
component.summary: Understand and manage what is installed on Fedora

description.p: Chapeau is a semantic layer over Fedora's native system mechanisms. It observes DNF, systemd and Flatpak, records relationships, and explains what is installed, why it is there, what depends on it, and what would change if it were removed.

ul.li: An intentional-resource view that hides supporting packages
Domains for organizing software the way you think about it
Removal impact previews before anything is executed
